comments.author: Zaxx
comments.body_html: First, thanks for this idea, it s changing the early game a lot for me. If we play with ORBIT, your mod is applied on the bots or they continue to receive quests by ORBIT generation in pre game ?

comments.author: Kazusa
comments.body_html:
I’m not completely sure how the two mods interact in actual gameplay, because I have not tested them together.

Based on ChatGPT’s review of both repositories, Kill & Bill should preserve the original quest IDs. It only replaces the quests’ AvailableForFinish conditions with kill, dogtag, or money requirements.

ORBIT appears to work separately from those player quest conditions. It seems to generate its own in-raid objectives for bots and use existing quest trigger locations on the map, rather than applying the rewritten quest requirements directly to them.

So the most likely result is:

  • Bots will continue receiving objectives generated by ORBIT.
  • Kill & Bill’s kill, dogtag, and money conditions will only apply to the player’s quests.
  • ORBIT may still send bots to the original quest locations, because Kill & Bill does not remove the map’s quest triggers.

However, this is only a code-based interpretation made by ChatGPT, not a confirmed compatibility test. I cannot guarantee that there are no unexpected interactions between the two mods.

comments.author: GSCGabeast
comments.body_html:
Hey, thanks for the great mod! two things tho:

1.) It doesn’t seem to overwrite the quests for AcidPhantasm’s Scorpion, any suggestion with this? 2.) Would you be able to have a version that preserve the location of the quests?

thanks! appreciate this mod a lot!

comments.author: Kazusa
comments.body_html:
Hey, thanks! Glad you’re enjoying the mod.

1.) From looking through the code, this appears to be caused by load order. Quest Condition Overhaul runs before Scorpion adds its quests to the database, so those quests are not present yet when my mod performs its changes. You could try using a mod or method that adjusts server mod loading order so Quest Condition Overhaul runs after Scorpion. I haven’t tested that setup myself, though.

2.) Preserving the original quest locations is something I may add as a configurable option in the future, but I can’t promise when—or whether—it will be implemented.

Thanks again for the feedback!❤️
